notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text identifies Distinguishing Subgroups of Narcissists with Latent Class Analysis, EUNIKE WETZEL, MARIUS LECKELT, TANJA M. GERLACH and MITJA D. It is the primary empirical journal article, including methods, results, tables and references, rather than an abstract-only excerpt or secondary report. No PDF path was supplied. Only es_value_o is assigned; all other fields/sides are placeholders. Target remains unresolved because the neutral input has no study/outcome/test locator and no requested original metric. Candidates include latent-class model fit statistics in Table 2 (p. 377), class-membership/gender chi-square tests in Sample 1 (17.81; p. 377), Sample 2 (23.06) and Sample 3 (17.71; p. 380), and Sample 4 (76.27; p. 385), each printed with p <.001; distinct trait-by-class unstandardized regression coefficients in Table 3 (p. 381); and distinct adjustment-outcome-by-class unstandardized regression coefficients in Table 5 (p. 384). For example, the canonical prose on p. 384 prints b = 0.37 for the low-narcissists/self-esteem comparison but describes the direction as below the reference mean; no sign reconstruction or metric conversion was performed. These are candidate evidence only, not assigned extracted values. No candidate was selected using row order or numeric matching. No analytic N was assigned or derived.
